cues.text: Port Island Station. You and Junpei walk up together with your school bags and stop near a flower shop at the foot of a staircase.
Junpei walks over to the flower shop and you follow him. A woman in an apron stands among the flowers.
Junpei spins around and hurries away from the shop. You turn and follow him out across the station plaza.
You and Junpei sit side by side on a bench in the plaza.
Junpei gets up and walks off across the plaza. You stay sitting on the bench.
